class.name: IfcSurfaceStyle
class.brief_description: IfcSurfaceStyle is an assignment of one or many surface style elements to a surface, defined by subtypes of IfcSurface , IfcFaceBasedSurfaceModel , IfcShellBasedSurfaceModel , or by subtypes of IfcSolidModel . members.member: An indication of which side of the surface to apply the style.
A collection of different surface styles.
